Getting started

Overview

What happens the moment you sign in.

Each user can securely log in to the system using their assigned username and password.

Once the user is verified through their login credentials, they are redirected to the Dashboard page, where they can manage the complete attendance management workflow from the mobile app.

Home base

Dashboard

The central hub for attendance, leave, and payroll‑related activities.

  • The Dashboard is the main landing page of the Attendance Management mobile app, serving as the central hub for all attendance, leave, and payroll‑related activities.
  • It provides employees with quick access to key functions such as attendance marking, leave requests, and record viewing.
  • Displays logged‑in user details including name, employee ID, current date, and a location indicator for attendance tracking.
  • Designed for efficiency, the Dashboard allows users to perform essential HR tasks without navigating through multiple menus.
  • Offers tailored functionality based on user roles (employee or otherwise) to support specific operational needs.
Workflow · 2 steps

Login process

Sign in with the credentials issued by your organization.

1

Enter your username, password, and URL

Fill in all three fields on the login screen before continuing.

Username: ED031 Password: ED031 URL: https://ezsoftwares.net:341
InformationCredentials above are shown as a format example — use the username and password issued to you by your admin.
2

Tap Log In

Tapping the Log In button verifies your credentials and redirects you straight to the Dashboard page.

Workflow · 2 steps

Attendance punch — IN and OUT

Mark your attendance directly from the Dashboard using GPS‑tagged punches.

1

Tap the location icon on the Dashboard

This opens the Attendance screen where punches are recorded.

2

Tap IN to punch in, or OUT to punch out

The Punch Time and Type are logged automatically the moment you tap.

NoteTap on a logged punch to view the exact location where it was recorded.
Workflow · 4 steps

Leave application process

Submit a new leave request and track ones you've already applied for.

1

Open the Leave menu

From the Dashboard, tap Leave to open the Leave Details page, where every leave you've applied for is listed.

2

Tap Apply Leave

This opens the Leave Application form. Tap the leave type field to see the available options, such as Privilege Leave.

3

Set the leave period, date, and reason

Select the leave period — Full Day, Half Day, and so on — then choose the date and enter the reason for your leave.

4

Tap Submit

This saves your leave application and sends it for approval.

Workflow · 3 steps

Attendance regularization (missed punch)

Correct a day where you forgot to punch in or out.

1

Open the Regularization menu

From the Dashboard, tap Regularization to open the Regularization Details page, listing every missed‑punch request you've applied for.

2

Tap Apply Missed Punch and fill in the form

  • Select the date you missed a punch on.
  • Change the shift (optional, if required).
  • Select a reason from the dropdown.
  • Select the IN and OUT time for that date.
  • Enter remarks (optional, if required).
3

Tap Submit

This saves your regularization record for approval.

Workflow · 1 step

Processed attendance report

View your processed IN and OUT records for any date range.

1

Search a date range on the Attendance menu

Navigate to the Attendance menu on the Dashboard, select a From date and a To date, then tap Search to view your attendance.

Workflow · 1 step

View leave balance

Check your remaining leave for the selected financial year.

1

Open the Leave menu

Tap the Leave menu on the Dashboard to view your leave balance for the selected financial year.

Workflow · 1 step

View GPS punch report

Review exactly where and when every punch was recorded.

1

Search a date range on the GPS Report menu

Navigate to the GPS Report menu on the Dashboard, select a From date and a To date, then tap Search.

ImportantTap the location icon to view exactly where a punch was recorded, and tap the eye icon to see the status card for that entry.
